item.title: Vixen Studio 3.13.4 alpha 6
item.description:
Changes

  • Backlog B73: agent workflow tools, gap analysis and agent guide (273391644)
  • Backlog B81: MCP-TOOLS.md counts B79's and B81's tools together (166) (e9ede4d31)
  • Backlog B81: tree-aware targetRegion, sequence palettes and effect looks (da42ece69)
  • Backlog B79: port old sequences with lag correction, grid snap and zones (21cecf885)
  • Backlog B91: onset timing no longer drifts late in a track (74ec8e3e7)
  • Backlog B77: music_rhythm and sequence_section_marks (206a4989d)
  • Backlog B80: section rebuilds, build ids, GUI-edit reports and labelled saves (1dea77ea1)
  • Backlog B90: check_studio_menu_bar.py runs offscreen again (000188fa3)
  • Backlog B85: retire StudioMenuBar for vanilla's WindowMenus (65a4917d6)
  • Backlog B78: render_analyze, automated taste checks on a rendered sequence (cb535a26b)
  • Backlog B89: tests find Cargo's target folder at runtime, so they run in worktrees (b70377dc8)
  • Backlog B76: feathered edges and exclusive zones for effect_band (57456b01f)
  • Backlog B88: media tools are found from the running executable's target folder (30a964f52)
  • Backlog B82: regression guards stop their bridge with SIGTERM so it removes its endpoint (8d8441778)
  • Backlog B82: sweep orphaned MCP sockets of other profiles when a server starts (4bb63ac72)
  • Backlog B75: MCP motifs place multi-effect templates on every mark (d01e641f8)
  • Backlog B87: schedule check accepts due as well as upcoming (beaa0e0f3)
  • Backlog B83: Window menu opens only the show window (6762757b2)
  • Backlog B72: RGBW single bulbs put white on W; full white reaches outputs at 255 (fc78cb489)
  • Backlog B70: Controllers Test menu offers Brightness and Stop Test (994608bf7)
  • Backlog B84: window menus show only with their window in front (dff57141c)
  • Backlog B69: one Tools menu; window menus only with their window in front (633e4aa12)
  • Backlog B74: a bad request never drops an MCP connection (0b4e4174a)
  • Backlog B71: Display pane never opens with empty Elements and Controllers lists (dd346ff08)
  • Tree handle: a tree that arrives after loadRoots gave up still loads its rows (45c774756)
  • Backlog B68: a plugin's passing unavailable status is no longer a permanent send error (fb9120ff2)
